aiContextDescription.message: Define context, architecture, and coding guidelines for the AI assistant. Applied to all projects. Use it for general coding standards and best practices.

aiContextPlaceholder.message:
# Project Context
## Architecture
- Describe your project structure
- Main files and their purpose
## Coding Style
- Language for comments: Spanish/English
- Use arrow functions
- Prefer const over let
## Best Practices
- Add JSDoc comments for functions
- Use meaningful variable names
- Handle errors with try-catch
## Response Format
- Explain in English
- Include code examples
